frozen_convention_notes_for_A1: ARM IDS: the selection freeze describes the anchor as 'OICYC'; the proposal's arms table (OICYC.md section 6) pins the arm IDs CYC-28D / CYC-14D / CTL-OISHARE -- the proposal (frozen identity) is followed; the freeze's 'OICYC anchor' is CYC-28D.

FOLD PURGE: implemented as the measured V13 calendar-zone convention ([end - 1d, end); exactly the 2026-04-20 stamp purged, leaving 51 effective Mondays at 17/17/17) -- the same counts A9F measured for this family (d2_a9f lane_handoff OICYC.schedule: fold_live_stamps 17/17/17, live 51). A9F-OBS-4's prose ('removes the 2025-12-22 stamp') is inconsistent with its own 17/17/17 counts and with the V13 measured convention; the counts are identical under both readings and the implementation is test-pinned.

FOLD-TERMINAL FORCE-FLAT: at each fold's last retained stamp the plugin returns the FLAT book (the liqepis V13R precedent: the purge zone alone cannot realise the fold's last LIVE book without straddling into the next fold). Real-snapshot preflight: transitions per fold = entry .. force-flat .. re-entry; fold-terminal actions are reported separately from discretionary decisions as OICYC.md requires.

DAY-ROW ALIGNMENT: feature rows are aligned by UTC day bucket (ONE row per symbol per day, manifest-pinned; the day's last snapshot can land before 23:55Z per A9F-OBS-7), availability stamped PER ROW; consecutive-ness by day-row index, never calendar arithmetic, never exact-stamp equality. This discharged the I-lane obligation A1 noted at selection ('D2 staging discharged the I-lane obligation' applied to PREMFADE staging; the OI staging was already SHA-pinned and is re-verified at every load).

CONTROL ORIENTATION: the control's frozen 'rank DESCENDING on SH_s' is carried as the descending average-tie rank presentation in payload diagnostics (rank 1 = highest share) while the BOOK is long lowest-share / short highest-share exactly as the proposal states; the median-exit hysteresis operates on the value ordering.

EXIT = FLIP: 'EXIT only when the rank crosses beyond the median' is implemented as exit-to-the-opposite-side (flip), mirroring the frozen V13 hysteresis family convention, with the exit band pinned at the median (the proposal's own tighter-than-V13 band); flat symbols enter only in their entry tercile.

The three oicyc scored cells were BLOCKED pre-metric.
delta_1.root_cause: plugin._fold_terminal_stamps(instants) derived the fold-terminal force-flat stamps from the RETAINED (stress-filtered) decision stamps: _chained_weights passed decision_instants(stress=stress) in, and fold_assignments refuses when any pinned fold has no retained members -- so the terminal derivation itself crashed whenever a fold was dropped. Fold terminals were treated as a property of the retained subset instead of a property of the frozen calendar.
delta_1.fix: research/v14/families/oicyc/plugin.py ONLY (delta sha256 15b1011d52310dfff2290607a1c1698e306a7144d41a6b659618b3bef8ec25a2): _fold_terminal_stamps() now derives the terminals (2025-12-15 / 2026-04-13 / 2026-08-17 -- each fold's last EFFECTIVE stamp) from the FULL frozen calendar (stamp_calendar() -> fold_assignments), the exact calendar-only derivation of the OITD/LIQEPIS V13 and basislv V14 precedents (research/v13/families/{oitd,liqepis}/plugin.py fold_terminal_force_flat_stamps; research/v14/families/basislv_premfade/plugin.py), and _chained_weights applies retention/drop as a FILTER (terminals & retained instants); a dropped fold's terminal is never a retained stamp so the chain never visits it. No frozen identity constant, window, book rule, cost, clock, threshold, or intact-schedule byte changed. No scored PnL was or is computed.
